EVERY PAGE OF THIS REPORT IS A PHOTOGRAPH -- pdfplumber returns 0 words on all 116 pages, tested per page -- so it was read off the page's OWN stored bitmap, not a re-render; NO recognition was used. THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, READ OFF THE PAGE AND WRITTEN DOWN (rule 13b.4), is `FUND NAME` | `BEGINNING BALANCE PRINCIPAL` | `BEGINNNING BALANCE EARNINGS` | `CONTRIB TO PRINCIPAL` | `NET EARNINGS` | `DISBURSE FROM PRINCIPAL` | `TRANSFERS OF EARNINGS` | `ENDING CASH VALUE` | `UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS` | `ENDING MARKET VALUE` -- the second one is printed with three Ns, `BEGINNNING`, and is transcribed here as the page spells it. Nine money columns, the same nine FY2015 prints, and the same two identities. WHAT PROVES IT: every fund row closes on BOTH identities, and the group's own printed SUBTOTAL closes in ALL NINE columns, exactly, no tolerance declared. ONE FIGURE WAS CORRECTED BY RE-READING, not by arithmetic: PERPETUAL CARE BEQUEST's BEGINNNING BALANCE EARNINGS reads $7,864.33. A first pass off a 0.42-scale render of the whole page read $7,884.33, which misses the row's own ending cash value by exactly $20.00 and the cemetery SUBTOTAL by the same $20.00. The figure was then re-read off a full-scale crop of that band and is $7,864.33 on the page -- the arithmetic said WHERE to look, the page said WHAT it says (rule 14). WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: nothing here reconciles these funds to the Treasurer's cash or to the general ledger; it is what this one statement prints about itself. GROUP: CONSERVATION FUNDS.

rows.proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG DEBT REPAYMENT SCHEDULE AS OF JUNE 30 2012`, PDF pages 76-77 of the FY2012 annual town report (4118-fy-2012-annual-town-report.pdf), printed folios 73-74. EVERY PAGE OF THIS REPORT IS A PHOTOGRAPH -- pdfplumber returns 0 words on all 116 pages -- so it was read off the pages' own 518 dpi bitmaps; NO recognition was used. THE PRINTED SHAPE, READ OFF THE PAGE AND WRITTEN DOWN (rule 13b.4): `FISCAL YEAR` across the top, FY2013 to FY2030 on p76 and FY2031 to FY2047 plus a `TOTAL` column on p77; fourteen debt issues down the side, each printing `PRINCIPAL`, `INTEREST` and a total row (`TOTAL MASS WATER POLL TRUST` or `TOTAL MUNICIPAL PURPOSE`), then `GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL`, `GRAND TOTAL INTEREST` and `TOTAL DEBT`. The issue-year cells are the reading (`kind=fund`); the per-issue TOTAL column and the GRAND TOTAL rows are recorded as `kind=line` so they are held without being counted twice. WHAT PROVES IT: the page states its arithmetic five ways and this reading closes on all five. (1) principal + interest = total on 185 of 185 issue-years, EXACTLY, at zero tolerance. (2) Each issue's years sum to the TOTAL column it prints. (3) Each year's issues sum to the printed GRAND TOTAL row. (4) GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL + GRAND TOTAL INTEREST = TOTAL DEBT in 34 of the 35 years. (5) The grand totals across all 35 years equal the printed TOTAL corner. NO TOLERANCE IS DECLARED. All three columns of this group close on the printed TOTAL corner at ZERO tolerance -- $26,479,503, $8,365,391 and $34,426,190 -- and all 185 issue-year identities close exactly. THE PAGE'S OWN GRAND TOTAL ROWS DRIFT BY A DOLLAR, and that is the page rounding rather than this reading. The schedule prints DISPLAYED WHOLE DOLLARS over amounts that carry cents, so a printed total is the rounded sum and not the sum of the rounded parts: the INTEREST row misses the issues beneath it by exactly $1 in five places (Mass Water Pool 4 and Mass Water Pool 14's TOTAL columns, and FY2016, FY2017 and FY2020's GRAND TOTAL INTEREST). PRINCIPAL misses NOWHERE -- not in any of the 14 row totals, any of the 35 year totals, or the corner. That contrast is what says rounding rather than a misread: one wrong digit cannot leave fifty independent principal sums perfect. Nothing was widened to make anything pass (rule 14). THE DOCUMENT CONTRADICTS ITSELF BY $418,704, AND IT IS RECORDED RATHER THAN MENDED. Mass Water Pool 9 prints a FY2024 PRINCIPAL of $418,704 and NO interest cell and NO total cell. GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL includes it -- FY2024's $846,635 is exactly the seven issue principals including it -- and TOTAL DEBT does not, so FY2024 prints $548,241 where its own two components make $966,945. The same $418,704 appears twice more: Mass Water Pool 9's TOTAL column prints $5,144,393 against a principal plus interest of $5,563,097, and the corner prints a TOTAL DEBT of $34,426,190 against $34,844,894. A THIRD CORROBORATION, FROM ANOTHER REPORT: the FY2013 annual town report prints the same schedule a year later and fails the same identity by the same $418,704 in the same fiscal year (`sources/data/page-reads/fy2013-p81-debt-schedule.csv`), and the FY2014 report prints a `MASS WATER POOL 9*` row with a principal of 418,704 in the FY2024 column and no interest and no total beside it. Three reports, one borrowing, one balloon payment. WHAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED: which figure is wrong. The town may be excluding a subsidised trust payment from TOTAL DEBT deliberately, or the principal row may be double-counting it, and nothing in any of the three reports distinguishes those.
